title: RAG quality project: ingestion, evaluation and CI
objectives: Implement the worked example and validate its boundary conditions
Use the diagnostic evidence to explain a release decision
relevance: In the fictional CI quality platform, this skill connects rag quality project: ingestion, evaluation and ci with test contracts, failure triage, and evidence for release. Acceptance includes Recall@K/MRR, groundedness calibration, citation validity, zero tenant leaks, no-answer abstention, Docker/service smoke checks and a failing CI gate for a known regression.

sections.title: Problem and intuition
paragraphs: A support assistant answers synthetic CI troubleshooting questions from approved documentation. Its quality depends on ingestion, retrieval, context packing and generation separately. A relevant answer without valid evidence is not accepted, and an unavailable index must yield a truthful fallback.
The portfolio result must be reproducible from the supplied synthetic fixtures and declared configuration. Keep a deterministic baseline visible alongside any live-provider results.

sections.title: Implement the mechanism
paragraphs: Build heading-aware chunks with document versions, retrieve with tenant filters, compare sparse and hybrid ranking, and construct cited context. Run golden cases with retrieval metrics, deterministic citation checks and an optional calibrated Ragas/DeepEval judge. Package the service and retain reports in CI.
The repository labs provide the domain entry points and fixture cases. Run the acceptance checks before recording project completion and keep the generated run ID in your field notes.
